subject: CYCLE-3 DESIGN: gated early-INNER secondary bridge after wake-race correction
body: Cycle-3 research design published after reconciling Manager's READY_FOR_PRIMARY A-D correctness dossier with newly recovered historical Fold7 dual-active evidence. This proposal does NOT compete with or supersede the openingAttempt/WAKE_COMMITTED/readiness/terminal-fencing correction. It is a gated post-correctness latency experiment. Historical 2026-09-30 device diagnostics prove the inverse dual-active direction: INNER default + COVER secondary could be enabled with cmd display, both built-ins reported ON, a display-bound secondary host remained usable and live mirror valid while Samsung later remapped logical ids. Current DisplayMirrorHost also proves Duo can create a display-bound accessibility-overlay window with stale-attempt/frame-commit ownership. Proposed Stage 0 is read-only: under the exact OpeningKey=(serviceEpoch, openingAttemptSequence), enumerate disabled/current displays immediately after WAKE_COMMITTED and prove whether a 1968x2184 INNER logical route exists materially before Samsung native handoff. Only if that gate passes, Stage 1 retains COVER as default/task/input owner, enables/revalidates the exact INNER route as secondary, attaches a dedicated InnerOpeningBridgeHost, and draws only a privacy-safe diagnostic marker. Success requires externally visible INNER pixels materially earlier than the current 50-60deg/native handoff, with no default/task/input migration, first-open crash, stale bridge, privacy regression, or close-path regression. State ON/visibleAfter/Beta2 shellUseful are explicitly non-authoritative; external-camera pixel evidence plus same-attempt software chronology is required. Stage 2 may reuse a sanitized owned opening frame only after Stage 1 passes. Logical ids are always ephemeral and rebound by physical identity after every mutation/topology event.
